title.zh: 认识和解释业务环境中的基础 AI 概念（例如，算法、模型、训练、推理、预测）。
title.en: Recognize and explain foundational AI concepts in business, including algorithms, models, training, inference and prediction.

title.zh: 区分 AI、机器学习 (ML) 和生成式人工智能 (GenAI)。
title.en: Distinguish AI, machine learning (ML), and generative AI (GenAI).

title.zh: 区分结构化数据和非结构化数据，并解释 AI 的数据类型相关性。
title.en: Distinguish structured and unstructured data and explain the relevance of data types to AI.

title.zh: 描述为什么数据质量对 AI 的输出结果有很大的影响。
title.en: Describe why data quality strongly affects AI outcomes.

title.zh: 解释与使用历史数据训练 AI 模型相关的概念。
title.en: Explain concepts associated with training AI models on historical data.

title.zh: 确保了解全球框架和统一的 AI 词汇表（例如，ISO/IEC 23053、ISO/IEC 42001）。
title.en: Demonstrate awareness of global frameworks and a shared AI vocabulary, including ISO/IEC 23053 and ISO/IEC 42001.

title.zh: 确定何时使用基于规则的自动化以及何时使用 AI 解决方案。
title.en: Determine when to use rule-based automation and when to use AI solutions.

title.zh: 将 AI 代理与其他 AI 解决方案区分开来，确定 AI 代理的核心功能（例如，自主性、工具使用、代理间通信和编排策略）。
title.en: Distinguish AI agents from other AI solutions and identify autonomy, tool use, inter-agent communication and orchestration strategies.

title.zh: 描述为什么需要持续监控和更新 AI 解决方案，以便检测和修复模型漂移和性能变化。
title.en: Describe why AI solutions require ongoing monitoring and updates to detect and correct drift and performance changes.

title.zh: 建立透明的 AI 工具分类体系（例如，已批准、已阻止、正在评估），减少影子 AI 风险。
title.en: Establish a transparent AI tool classification, such as approved, blocked and under evaluation, to reduce shadow AI risk.

title.zh: 应用基本的提示工程原理来实现所需的 AI 输出。
title.en: Apply basic prompt engineering principles to achieve desired AI outputs.

title.zh: 确定词元限制或上下文窗口限制何时影响生成式人工智能系统性能。
title.en: Determine when token limits or context-window limits affect generative AI performance.

title.zh: 认识模型自适应技术（例如，检索增强生成 [RAG]、微调）如何改善 AI 对特定业务需求的响应。
title.en: Recognize how adaptation methods, including RAG and fine-tuning, can improve responses to specific business needs.

title.zh: 确定跨业务职能（例如，客户运营、销售和营销、研发、软件开发）的高影响力 AI 使用案例，并将 AI 功能与特定业务成果对应起来。
title.en: Identify high-impact AI use cases across business functions and map capabilities to specific business outcomes.

title.zh: 评估 AI 实施的自建、购买或合作开发决策（考虑的因素包括预算、时间表、能力、供应商提议和监管合规要求）。
title.en: Assess build, buy or partner decisions considering budget, timelines, capability, vendor proposals and regulatory requirements.

title.zh: 根据商业价值、可行性、可持续性和战略契合度，来确定 AI 计划的优先级（决定是扩展、暂停还是终止计划）。
title.en: Prioritize AI initiatives by business value, feasibility, sustainability and strategic fit; decide whether to scale, pause or terminate.

title.zh: 确定在什么情况下 AI 并非解决业务问题的合适解决方案。
title.en: Identify situations where AI is not an appropriate solution to a business problem.

title.zh: 针对准备将业务流程转向基于 AI 的解决方案或在不同 AI 平台之间进行迁移的情况，评估关键注意事项（例如，业务连续性、成本影响、数据准备情况、性能影响）。
title.en: Assess business continuity, costs, data readiness and performance when moving business processes to AI or between AI platforms.

title.zh: 为 AI 计划定义关键绩效指标 (KPI)，包括有形收益（例如，降低成本、增加收入）和无形收益（例如，客户满意度、员工生产力）。
title.en: Define KPIs for AI initiatives covering tangible benefits such as cost reduction and revenue, and intangible benefits such as satisfaction and productivity.

title.zh: 在实施 AI 解决方案之前先建立基准指标，以便准确衡量采用 AI 带来的成果。
title.en: Establish baseline metrics before AI implementation to measure adoption outcomes accurately.

title.zh: 通过使用全面的框架来计算 AI 的投资回报 (ROI)（例如节省时间、降低成本、增加收入、提升生产力）。
title.en: Calculate AI ROI using a comprehensive framework covering time savings, cost reduction, revenue and productivity.

title.zh: 确定用于预测 AI 项目成功与否的先导性指标。
title.en: Identify leading indicators that may predict AI project success.

title.zh: 为 AI 实施建立基本的成本因素控制措施，包括成本规划和优化策略。
title.en: Establish basic AI cost controls, including cost planning and optimization strategies.

title.zh: 评估竞争格局并确定采用 AI 的优势。
title.en: Assess the competitive landscape and identify advantages of adopting AI.

title.zh: 确定使用 AI 解决方案实现业务模式转型的机会。
title.en: Identify opportunities for business-model transformation using AI.

title.zh: 描述 AI 如何推动实现可持续的竞争优势和运营改进。
title.en: Describe how AI can drive sustainable competitive advantage and operational improvement.

title.zh: 根据行业成熟度和竞争动态，确定合适的 AI 投资水平。
title.en: Determine appropriate AI investment levels based on industry maturity and competitive dynamics.

title.zh: 在业务场景中应用负责任的 AI 原则和维度（例如，公平性、可说明性、隐私、安全、透明度、稳健性）。
title.en: Apply responsible AI principles in business, including fairness, explainability, privacy, security, transparency and robustness.

title.zh: 当业务目标与负责任的 AI 原则冲突时，进行权衡取舍。
title.en: Evaluate trade-offs when business objectives conflict with responsible AI principles.

title.zh: 确定在 AI 项目规划中应何时融入负责任的 AI 实践，确保在设计时便纳入了监管措施。
title.en: Identify when to integrate responsible AI practices into planning so governance controls are included by design.

title.zh: 识别 AI 系统需要人工监督的情况，并确定适当的保障措施（例如，幻觉检测、防护机制、进行上报的标准）。
title.en: Identify situations requiring human oversight and appropriate safeguards, including hallucination detection, guardrails and escalation criteria.

title.zh: 建立具有合理跨职能部门代表性和明确问责机制的 AI 监管结构。
title.en: Establish AI governance with suitable cross-functional representation and clear accountability.

title.zh: 确定并解决使用 AI 的业务流程的监管合规风险。
title.en: Identify and address regulatory compliance risks in AI-enabled business processes.

title.zh: 针对 AI 系统，确定合适的访问控制和数据安全措施。
title.en: Identify appropriate access controls and data security measures for AI systems.

title.zh: 应用 AI 风险分类框架，确立 AI 生命周期中监管和合规性决策的优先顺序。
title.en: Apply AI risk classification frameworks to prioritize lifecycle governance and compliance decisions.

title.zh: 确定生产环境中 AI 系统的风险控制和监控机制需求。
title.en: Identify production AI risk-control and monitoring requirements.

title.zh: 了解在 AI 生命周期的多个阶段中可能会出现偏差，并说明持续监控偏差偏移的重要性。
title.en: Recognize that bias can arise at multiple AI lifecycle stages and explain the importance of ongoing bias monitoring.

title.zh: 管理 AI 系统的有害内容风险和知识产权 (IP) 问题。
title.en: Manage harmful-content risks and intellectual-property issues in AI systems.

title.zh: 确定并减轻与 AI 系统可靠性相关的风险（例如，幻觉、数据质量下降、模型漂移）。
title.en: Identify and mitigate reliability risks, including hallucinations, declining data quality and model drift.

title.zh: 根据各关键维度（例如，领导层共识、数据质量、文化适应性、技术基础设施、监管框架），评估企业在采用 AI 方面的准备情况。
title.en: Assess organizational AI readiness across leadership alignment, data quality, cultural adaptability, infrastructure and governance.

title.zh: 运用 AI 成熟度模型，评估企业在 AI 旅程中所处的阶段（例如实验阶段、企业规模部署阶段）。
title.en: Apply AI maturity models to assess stages such as experimentation and enterprise deployment.

title.zh: 确定在人员、流程、技术和监管等方面阻碍 AI 成功转型的具体能力差距。
title.en: Identify specific capability gaps in people, processes, technology and governance that obstruct AI transformation.

title.zh: 确定开发投资的优先顺序，并根据战略目标和当前业务成熟度水平制定发展路线。
title.en: Prioritize development investments and create a roadmap based on strategic goals and current maturity.

title.zh: 评估数据准备情况（包括数据质量、可访问性），以及数据孤岛对 AI 计划的影响。
title.en: Assess data readiness, including quality, accessibility and the impact of data silos.

title.zh: 描述为 AI 奠定基础的数据策略、数据所有权和数据共享框架的重要性。
title.en: Describe the importance of data strategy, ownership and sharing frameworks for AI foundations.

title.zh: 评估支持 AI 计划的基础技术和基础设施要求。
title.en: Assess foundational technology and infrastructure requirements for AI initiatives.

title.zh: 建立高管层支持和领导层共识，识别并赋能 AI 倡导者，在整个企业中保持发展动力。
title.en: Build executive sponsorship and leadership alignment, and identify and empower AI champions to sustain momentum.

title.zh: 组建涵盖不同专业领域（例如业务负责人、技术专家、法律、合规性等）的跨职能团队，并为 AI 计划制定明确的责任标准。
title.en: Form cross-functional teams including business, technical, legal and compliance expertise, with clear responsibility standards.

title.zh: 制定透明的沟通策略，解决员工对 AI 的担忧（例如，实施时间表、预期结果、对员工角色的影响）。
title.en: Develop transparent communication addressing employee concerns about timelines, expected outcomes and role impacts.

title.zh: 认识 AI 采用中的文化障碍（例如，规避风险、抗拒改变、害怕失败），并确定领导层用来应对这些问题的干预措施。
title.en: Recognize cultural barriers such as risk aversion, resistance and fear of failure, and identify leadership interventions.

title.zh: 确定合适的员工培养方法，来加速提升整个企业的 AI 素养（例如，概念验证 [POC] 计划、黑客马拉松、培训计划、负责任的 AI 培训）。
title.en: Identify workforce development methods to accelerate AI literacy, including proofs of concept, hackathons and responsible AI training.

title.zh: 发现各种机会来转变人员的角色，从人工操作转向人工监督并与 AI 系统进行协作，以及制定战略决策，在人工优势（例如批判性思维、同理心、创造力）与 AI 功能之间取得平衡。
title.en: Identify opportunities to move roles from manual operations toward human oversight, AI collaboration and strategic decisions, balancing human strengths and AI capabilities.

title.zh: 采用分阶段进行的迭代式转型方法（例如，构想、实验、启动、扩展）。
title.en: Adopt a phased iterative transformation approach, such as envision, experiment, launch and scale.

title.zh: 实施扩展方法，从短期成果开始，再逐步扩大到全企业部署。
title.en: Implement scaling methods that begin with short-term results and expand to enterprise deployment.

title.zh: 建立 AI 卓越中心 (COE) 和跨职能协作机制来支持扩展。
title.en: Establish an AI center of excellence and cross-functional collaboration mechanisms to support scaling.

title.zh: 建立持续的反馈机制和成功指标，用于跟踪 AI 计划的进展和长期价值。
title.en: Establish ongoing feedback and success metrics to track AI initiatives and long-term value.

title.zh: 处理 AI 计划从实验阶段转向生产阶段的过渡，包括监管和运营要求。
title.en: Manage the transition from AI experiments to production, including governance and operational requirements.

title.zh: 评估整个 AI 扩展计划在全企业推广中的多方面因素，确保业务连续性和性能。
title.en: Assess the multiple factors involved in enterprise-wide AI scaling to ensure business continuity and performance.

explanation.zh: 人工智能是较广的领域，关注让系统执行与智能有关的任务。机器学习是其中一类方法，并非所有自动化都需要机器学习。
explanation.en: Artificial intelligence is a broad field concerned with enabling systems to perform tasks associated with intelligence. Machine learning is one family of approaches within it; not all automation requires machine learning.

examples.zh: 清晰、固定的审批条件可直接编写规则，无需为了使用AI而换成模型。
examples.en: Clear, fixed approval conditions can be implemented directly as rules; there is no need to replace them with a model just to use AI.

evidence.quote: technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.
all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

explanation.zh: 机器学习利用数据学习模式，而不是为所有情况逐一编写规则。数据、目标和验证方式共同影响模型是否适用。
explanation.en: Machine learning learns patterns from data instead of requiring an explicit rule for every case. The data, objective and validation method jointly affect whether a model is suitable.

examples.zh: 通过历史交易学习异常模式，与人工写定额阈值规则不同。
examples.en: Learning unusual patterns from historical transactions differs from manually setting a fixed threshold rule.

evidence.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 使用多层神经网络学习数据表示的机器学习方法；它属于机器学习，而不是与AI并列的领域。
explanation.en: Deep learning is a machine learning approach that uses multilayer neural networks to learn data representations. It belongs within machine learning, rather than being a field at the same level as AI.

examples.zh: 识别商品照片中的缺陷。
examples.en: Identify defects in product photographs.

evidence.quote: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning driven by multilayered neural networks

explanation.zh: 由相连的计算节点和可学习权重组成的模型，通过层间计算处理输入。
explanation.en: A neural network is a model composed of connected computational nodes and learnable weights that processes inputs through computations across layers.

examples.zh: 学习交易特征与欺诈风险的关系。
examples.en: Learn the relationship between transaction features and fraud risk.

evidence.quote: stacks simple "neurons" in layers and learns pattern-recognizing weights and biases from data to map inputs to outputs.

explanation.zh: 使计算机处理和分析人类语言的AI领域，任务包括分类、抽取和翻译。
explanation.en: Natural language processing is an AI field that enables computers to process and analyze human language, including classification, extraction and translation tasks.

examples.zh: 从工单文字中识别客户诉求。
examples.en: Identify a customer's request from the text of a support ticket.

evidence.quote: NLP tools can automatically classify, extract key information and summarize content

explanation.zh: 从图像或视频中提取和解释信息的AI领域。
explanation.en: Computer vision is an AI field that extracts and interprets information from images or video.

examples.zh: 从产线照片中定位瑕疵。
examples.en: Locate defects in photographs from a production line.

evidence.quote: process, analyze and interpret visual inputs such as images and videos.

explanation.zh: 生成式AI能产生文本、图像等内容。语言流畅并不等于事实正确，业务使用需要核对事实、适用性与复核成本。
explanation.en: Generative AI can produce content such as text and images. Fluent language does not imply factual correctness; business use requires checking facts, suitability and the cost of review.

examples.zh: 起草访谈摘要之后，由负责人对照原文检查遗漏和误解。
examples.en: After drafting an interview summary, the responsible person checks it against the original for omissions and misunderstandings.

evidence.quote: technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.
produces outputs that sound plausible but are factually wrong, irrelevant or entirely fabricated.

explanation.zh: 算法是一套可执行的方法或步骤。模型训练也依照算法进行，但算法本身不是训练后得到的模型。
explanation.en: An algorithm is an executable method or sequence of steps. Model training follows algorithms, but an algorithm is not itself the resulting trained model.

examples.zh: 按订单金额排序是一种算法；从订单记录学习需求规律则会得到预测模型。
examples.en: Sorting orders by value is an algorithm; learning demand patterns from order records produces a predictive model.

evidence.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 模型是用于将输入映射为输出的表示。在机器学习中，模型的参数通过训练从数据中学习。它的输出需要根据任务目标验证。
explanation.en: A model is a representation used to map inputs to outputs. In machine learning, model parameters are learned from data through training. Its outputs must be validated against the task objective.

examples.zh: 将历史销量与日期输入需求模型，得到下一周销量估计。
examples.en: Feed historical sales and dates into a demand model to estimate next week's sales.

evidence.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。
explanation.en: Training uses existing examples to adjust model parameters so the model learns patterns in data. Good training performance does not guarantee good performance on new data; independent validation is needed.

examples.zh: 用过去的订单记录学习需求规律，之后用未参与训练的时段检验。
examples.en: Learn demand patterns from past order records, then evaluate on a period not used in training.

evidence.quote: In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 推理是使用已训练的模型处理新输入。训练改变参数；推理通常使用已有参数产生预测或生成内容。
explanation.en: Inference uses a trained model to process new inputs. Training changes parameters; inference usually uses existing parameters to produce predictions or generated content.

examples.zh: 上线的客服模型为一张新工单起草回复，属于推理。
examples.en: A deployed customer service model drafts a reply to a new ticket: this is inference.

evidence.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.
In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.

explanation.zh: 预测是利用输入和已学习的模式估计未知结果。业务评价既要看误差，也要看错误会造成的后果。
explanation.en: Prediction uses inputs and learned patterns to estimate an unknown outcome. Business evaluation must consider both error and the consequences of mistakes.

examples.zh: 需求高估可能造成库存积压；低估则可能造成缺货。
examples.en: Overestimating demand may create excess inventory; underestimating it may cause stockouts.

evidence.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.

explanation.zh: 使用带有目标标签的样本学习输入到目标的映射，可用于分类和回归。
explanation.en: Supervised learning uses examples with target labels to learn a mapping from inputs to targets. It can be used for classification and regression.

examples.zh: 利用已标记是否欺诈的交易训练分类器。
examples.en: Train a classifier using transactions labeled as fraudulent or not fraudulent.

evidence.quote: Supervised learning is a machine learning technique that uses labeled data sets to train artificial intelligence

explanation.zh: 从没有目标标签的数据中寻找结构或模式，例如将相似对象聚类。
explanation.en: Unsupervised learning looks for structure or patterns in data without target labels, for example by clustering similar objects.

examples.zh: 按购买特征形成客户分群。
examples.en: Segment customers by their purchasing characteristics.

evidence.quote: analyze and cluster unlabeled data sets. These algorithms discover hidden patterns or data groupings

explanation.zh: 智能体通过与环境交互和奖励反馈学习行动策略，关注长期累计回报。
explanation.en: In reinforcement learning, an agent learns an action policy through interactions with its environment and reward feedback, with a focus on long-term cumulative return.

examples.zh: 在模拟环境中学习库存补货策略。
examples.en: Learn an inventory replenishment policy in a simulated environment.

evidence.quote: The agent’s only objective is to maximize its cumulative rewards from the environment.

explanation.zh: 结构化数据有相对明确的字段或模式，便于按统一口径查询、统计和校验。结构清晰不等于内容必然准确。
explanation.en: Structured data has relatively well-defined fields or a schema, making it easier to query, summarize and validate consistently. A clear structure does not guarantee accurate contents.

examples.zh: 订单表中的日期、商品编号、数量，是明确的字段。
examples.en: Dates, product identifiers and quantities in an order table are explicit fields.

evidence.quote: Structured data has a strict, predefined data model. Unstructured data does not have a predefined format.

explanation.zh: 非结构化数据通常不像关系表那样具有固定字段结构，常见形式有正文、图片和录音。使用前可能需要提取与组织信息。
explanation.en: Unstructured data typically lacks the fixed field structure of a relational table; common forms include prose, images and audio recordings. Information may need to be extracted and organized before use.

examples.zh: 客户录音可先转写，再提取诉求；不能把转写过程当成事实核验。
examples.en: A customer recording can first be transcribed and then analyzed for requests; transcription must not be mistaken for fact-checking.

evidence.quote: Structured data has a strict, predefined data model. Unstructured data does not have a predefined format.

explanation.zh: 数据质量要结合用途检查准确性、完整性、一致性、时效性及相关性。更大的模型无法自动补救所有数据缺陷。
explanation.en: Data quality must be assessed for the intended use, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness and relevance. A larger model cannot automatically repair every data defect.

examples.zh: 销售数据存在重复订单，先调查重复来源再比较模型方案。
examples.en: If sales data contains duplicate orders, investigate the source of duplication before comparing model options.

evidence.quote: accuracy, completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness and fitness for purpose

explanation.zh: 历史数据反映过去的条件。要用独立数据检验模型能否处理未见情况，并留意未来环境与历史数据是否不同。
explanation.en: Historical data reflects past conditions. Use independent data to test whether a model can handle unseen cases, and watch for differences between future conditions and historical data.

examples.zh: 用过去节日销量训练的模型，遇到新的促销方式时仍需监测。
examples.en: A model trained on past holiday sales still needs monitoring when new promotion methods are introduced.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 训练数据用于学习，独立验证或测试用于检验未见样本的表现。把测试答案带入训练会让结果显得过于乐观。
explanation.en: Training data is used for learning; independent validation or testing assesses performance on unseen examples. Bringing test answers into training makes results look overly optimistic.

examples.zh: 不要将上线测试工单的标准答案直接放进待评估模型的输入。
examples.en: Do not directly include the reference answers for deployment test tickets in the input to the model being evaluated.

evidence.quote: models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 团队应先统一算法、模型、训练和推理等词的含义，再讨论方案。标准或框架可以帮助组织概念，但不能当作准确率保证。
explanation.en: Teams should first agree on the meanings of terms such as algorithm, model, training and inference before discussing solutions. Standards or frameworks can organize concepts, but do not guarantee accuracy.

examples.zh: 业务说的“模型上线”与技术说的“模型训练完成”不是同一件事。
examples.en: What business staff call model deployment is not the same as what technical staff call completion of model training.

evidence.quote: provides a conceptual framework and shared terminology for describing artificial intelligence (AI) systems that use machine learning (ML).

explanation.zh: 按本课程大纲，需了解ISO/IEC 23053与ISO/IEC 42001等框架。前者关注使用机器学习的AI系统框架，后者关注组织AI管理体系；具体要求应查正式标准。
explanation.en: This course outline calls for awareness of frameworks such as ISO/IEC 23053 and ISO/IEC 42001. The former concerns a framework for AI systems using machine learning; the latter concerns organizational AI management systems. Consult the formal standards for specific requirements.

examples.zh: 讨论组织责任和管理流程时，不把管理体系标准解释为模型零错误认证。
examples.en: When discussing organizational responsibilities and management processes, do not interpret a management system standard as certifying an error-free model.

evidence.quote: provides a conceptual framework and shared terminology for describing artificial intelligence (AI) systems that use machine learning (ML).
establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) within organizations.

explanation.zh: 条件明确且稳定时，优先考虑确定性规则。模式复杂、规则难穷举时再评估AI；比较价值、错误后果和维护成本。
explanation.en: When conditions are clear and stable, consider deterministic rules first. When patterns are complex and rules are difficult to enumerate, evaluate AI; compare value, consequences of error and maintenance costs.

examples.zh: 报销超过明确金额需审批，可以先采用固定规则。
examples.en: If expenses above a clearly specified amount require approval, a fixed rule can be used first.

evidence.quote: all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

explanation.zh: 代理围绕目标协调步骤和工具，可能具有一定自主性。代理的行动权限、失败处理和监督方式需要单独设计。
explanation.en: An agent coordinates steps and tools around a goal and may have some autonomy. Its action permissions, failure handling and supervision must be designed separately.

examples.zh: 能调用退款工具的助手，需要退款额度、日志和人工升级边界。
examples.en: An assistant that can call a refund tool needs refund limits, logs and boundaries for escalation to a human.

evidence.quote: Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.
define the APIs that can be called, how to handle the action, and how to return the response.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

explanation.zh: 多个代理的角色分工、信息交换和执行顺序属于编排问题。角色越多不自动代表效果越好，要检查任务完成与交接质量。
explanation.en: Dividing roles, exchanging information and ordering execution among multiple agents are orchestration problems. More roles do not automatically improve results; check task completion and handoff quality.

examples.zh: 检索代理交给起草代理的资料仍需保留来源和访问范围。
examples.en: Materials passed from a retrieval agent to a drafting agent must retain their sources and access scope.

evidence.quote: the process of coordinating multiple specialized AI agents within a unified system to efficiently achieve shared objectives.

explanation.zh: 输入分布或业务关系变化可能使模型表现变差。部署后持续观察质量、成本和反馈，发现变化后调查原因并纠正。
explanation.en: Changes in input distributions or business relationships may degrade model performance. After deployment, continually observe quality, cost and feedback, investigate changes and take corrective action.

examples.zh: 客户群变化后投诉分类变差，应调查新文本与原有训练样本的差别。
examples.en: If complaint classification deteriorates after the customer population changes, investigate differences between new text and the original training examples.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

explanation.zh: 明确哪些工具已批准、受限、被阻止或仍在评估，说明数据使用边界并提供合适替代方案，有助于减少未经批准的使用。
explanation.en: Clearly identify tools as approved, restricted, blocked or under evaluation. Explain data-use boundaries and provide suitable alternatives to help reduce unapproved use.

examples.zh: 员工需要处理敏感文档时，应知道可用工具和求助渠道。
examples.en: Employees handling sensitive documents should know which tools and support channels are available.

evidence.quote: without the formal approval or oversight of the information technology (IT) department.

explanation.zh: 规则系统把明确条件映射到动作。同一输入和规则版本应产生同一结果，适合固定阈值、必填校验和明确审批政策。
explanation.en: A rule-based system maps explicit conditions to actions. The same input and rule version should yield the same result, making it suitable for fixed thresholds, required-field checks and explicit approval policies.

examples.zh: 报销超过5000元必须审批，用金额规则执行。
examples.en: Enforce approval for expenses above 5,000 yuan using an amount-based rule.

misconceptions.zh: 不是所有自动化都需要学习模型。
misconceptions.en: Not all automation needs a learning model.

evidence.quote: A clearly specified mathematical process for computation; a set of rules that, if followed, will give a prescribed result.
all machine learning is AI, but not all AI is machine learning.

title.zh: 预测、生成与行动的边界
title.en: Boundaries between prediction, generation and action

explanation.zh: 预测估计未知结果；生成产生新内容；代理协调工具和步骤执行目标。一个业务系统可以组合三者，应分别验收预测误差、内容质量和行动权限。
explanation.en: Prediction estimates unknown outcomes; generation creates new content; an agent coordinates tools and steps to pursue a goal. A business system can combine all three, but should separately assess prediction error, content quality and action permissions.

examples.zh: 预测缺货后起草补货建议，实际下单仍需授权。
examples.en: After predicting a stockout, draft a replenishment suggestion; placing the actual order still requires authorization.

misconceptions.zh: 能写出行动建议，不等于已被允许执行。
misconceptions.en: Being able to write an action recommendation does not mean permission to execute it has been granted.

evidence.quote: AI inference is the act of using a trained AI model to make predictions on new data.
technology that enables computers and machines to simulate human learning, comprehension, problem solving, decision making, creativity and autonomy.
Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

explanation.zh: 代理的自主性是无需逐步人工指令即可选择行动的程度。应明确目标、可用工具、次数或金额限制、停止条件和异常升级，而不是把自主性理解为无限权限。
explanation.en: Agent autonomy is the degree to which an agent can choose actions without step-by-step human instructions. Define goals, available tools, limits on attempts or amounts, stopping conditions and escalation for exceptions; autonomy does not mean unlimited permission.

examples.zh: 连续两次检索失败后停止，转给人工核对。
examples.en: Stop after two consecutive failed retrieval attempts and transfer the task to a human for checking.

misconceptions.zh: 自主性越高，监督和边界越不能省略。
misconceptions.en: Greater autonomy makes supervision and boundaries more necessary, not optional.

evidence.quote: Although AI agents are autonomous in their decision-making processes, they require goals and predefined rules defined by humans.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

title.zh: 工具契约与最小行动权限
title.en: Tool contracts and least action privileges

explanation.zh: 工具调用需要约定输入、输出、错误、授权和副作用。退款、发邮件等改变外部状态的工具，应在服务端检查权限并保存审计记录。
explanation.en: Tool calls require agreements on inputs, outputs, errors, authorization and side effects. Tools that change external state, such as refunding or sending email, should check permissions on the server and retain audit records.

examples.zh: 退款工具拒绝超过额度的请求，并记录调用者。
examples.en: A refund tool rejects requests above the limit and logs the caller.

misconceptions.zh: 提示词中的提醒不能替代服务端权限检查。
misconceptions.en: Reminders in a prompt cannot replace server-side authorization checks.

evidence.quote: define the APIs that can be called, how to handle the action, and how to return the response.
you must attach a resource-based policy to the function to provide permissions for the agent.
Use multiple, dedicated, least privileged roles for each task.

explanation.zh: 多代理编排规定谁做什么、传什么证据以及何时交接。串行流程适合依赖关系，受控并行可处理独立任务；交接应保留来源、状态和失败责任。
explanation.en: Multi-agent orchestration specifies who does what, which evidence is passed and when handoffs occur. Sequential workflows suit dependent tasks, while controlled parallelism can handle independent tasks. Handoffs should retain sources, status and responsibility for failures.

examples.zh: 检索角色交付带出处的资料，审核角色核对后交给起草者。
examples.en: A retrieval role delivers sourced material; a review role checks it before passing it to the drafter.

misconceptions.zh: 增加角色数量本身不是质量证据。
misconceptions.en: Increasing the number of roles is not itself evidence of quality.

evidence.quote: the process of coordinating multiple specialized AI agents within a unified system to efficiently achieve shared objectives.

explanation.zh: 数据漂移是输入分布变化；概念漂移是输入与目标关系变化。发现分布变化不等于已经证明业务损害，需要结合真实结果和任务指标调查。
explanation.en: Data drift is a change in the input distribution; concept drift is a change in the relationship between inputs and targets. Detecting a distribution change does not prove business harm; investigate using actual outcomes and task metrics.

examples.zh: 新客户用词变了是输入变化，促销使同一价格对应的需求改变是关系变化。
examples.en: Different wording from new customers is an input change; a promotion changing demand at the same price is a relationship change.

misconceptions.zh: 不能看到漂移告警就不加验证地自动重训上线。
misconceptions.en: Do not automatically retrain and deploy without validation merely because a drift alert fires.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 上线前记录可比较的质量、延迟、成本和失败率。运行时监测变化，调查原因，验证修复，再决定重训、回退或调整用途。
explanation.en: Before deployment, record comparable baselines for quality, latency, cost and failure rate. During operation, monitor changes, investigate causes and validate fixes before deciding to retrain, roll back or adjust the use case.

examples.zh: 投诉分类准确率下降时，抽查新样本并比较旧版模型。
examples.en: When complaint classification accuracy falls, inspect new examples and compare with the previous model version.

misconceptions.zh: 一次上线验收不能替代持续监测。
misconceptions.en: A one-time deployment acceptance test cannot replace continuous monitoring.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.

explanation.zh: 把工具标为已批准、受限、评估中或禁止，同时说明适用数据和用途。影子AI是未经组织批准或管理的使用，应提供可用替代、培训和反馈渠道。
explanation.en: Classify tools as approved, restricted, under evaluation or prohibited, and specify applicable data and uses. Shadow AI means use without organizational approval or management; provide usable alternatives, training and feedback channels.

examples.zh: 公开可用工具清单，并提供敏感文档的合规处理渠道。
examples.en: Publish a list of available tools and provide a compliant channel for processing sensitive documents.

misconceptions.zh: 只列禁用名单而不解决工作需求，难以形成可执行治理。
misconceptions.en: A blocklist alone, without addressing work needs, makes governance difficult to carry out.

evidence.quote: without the formal approval or oversight of the information technology (IT) department.

explanation.zh: 提示应说明目标、必要背景、约束和期望输出。用代表性任务测试提示，避免只看一条漂亮回答。
explanation.en: Prompts should state the objective, necessary context, constraints and expected output. Test prompts on representative tasks instead of judging them from one attractive response.

examples.zh: 要求依据提供的访谈生成三点摘要，并为每点标出对应原文。
examples.en: Ask for a three-point summary based on a supplied interview, identifying the corresponding original passage for each point.

evidence.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.
the task or instruction you want the LLMs to perform, the context of the task

explanation.zh: 模型一次请求可处理的上下文有上限，输入与输出预算需要规划。资料过多时应筛选相关片段，而不是假设全部文件都会被有效使用。
explanation.en: There is a limit to the context a model can process in one request, so plan input and output budgets. When there is too much material, select relevant passages rather than assuming every file will be used effectively.

examples.zh: 先按章节切分教材，再提供与当前问题直接相关的段落。
examples.en: Split a textbook by chapter first, then provide passages directly relevant to the current question.

evidence.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.
The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

explanation.zh: RAG先检索相关且获授权的资料，再把资料提供给生成过程。它改善可用信息条件，但不保证检索和回答一定正确。
explanation.en: RAG first retrieves relevant, authorized material and then supplies it to generation. It improves the information available, but does not guarantee correct retrieval or answers.

examples.zh: 制度频繁更新时，核对检索资料的版本、权限和回答引用。
examples.en: For frequently changing policies, check the retrieved material's version, permissions and the answer's citations.

evidence.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.
produces outputs that sound plausible but are factually wrong, irrelevant or entirely fabricated.

explanation.zh: 微调利用训练样本调整模型行为或任务适应性。它与在请求中加入新资料不同，也不能替代对不断变化事实的维护。
explanation.en: Fine-tuning uses training examples to adjust model behavior or adapt it to a task. It differs from adding new material to a request and cannot replace maintenance of continually changing facts.

examples.zh: 统一输出风格与补充最新制度属于不同需求，先辨别问题再选技术。
examples.en: Standardizing output style and supplying the latest policy are different needs; identify the problem before choosing a technique.

evidence.quote: fine-tuning entails techniques to further train a model whose weights have already been updated through prior training.
references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.

title.zh: 任务、上下文、约束与格式

explanation.zh: 提示应交代要做的工作、相关资料、不可越过的边界及期望输出。把原始资料与操作指令分隔，能减少模型把文档文字误当指令的机会。
explanation.en: A prompt should state the work to do, relevant material, boundaries that must not be crossed and the expected output. Separating source material from operational instructions can reduce the chance that document text is mistaken for an instruction.

examples.zh: 依据访谈提取三项需求，逐项引用，未出现的内容写未知。
examples.en: Extract three requirements from an interview, cite each one, and write unknown for information that is absent.

misconceptions.zh: 更长的提示不必然更好，必须验证输出是否满足任务。
misconceptions.en: A longer prompt is not necessarily better; verify that the output satisfies the task.

evidence.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.
the task or instruction you want the LLMs to perform, the context of the task

title.zh: 代表性样例与提示版本

explanation.zh: 用典型、边界和失败案例测试提示，记录版本和成功标准。少样本示例应展示期望任务模式，而不是把测试题答案泄漏给模型。
explanation.en: Test prompts with typical, boundary and failure cases, recording versions and success criteria. Few-shot examples should demonstrate the intended task pattern rather than leak test answers to the model.

examples.zh: 同时测试普通工单、缺失资料工单与无权访问工单。
examples.en: Test ordinary tickets, tickets with missing information and tickets involving unauthorized access.

misconceptions.zh: 单次漂亮回答不能证明提示可稳定复用。
misconceptions.en: One impressive answer does not demonstrate reliable reuse of a prompt.

evidence.quote: few-shot prompting, which provides the model with sample outputs to clarify expectations.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.
the task or instruction you want the LLMs to perform, the context of the task

explanation.zh: 上下文窗口有限。规划时需计入指令、检索片段、历史对话、工具消息和预留输出，超过限制时应筛选、压缩或拆分。
explanation.en: Context windows are limited. Budget for instructions, retrieved passages, conversation history, tool messages and reserved output; select, compress or split material when limits would be exceeded.

examples.en: With a window of 8,000 tokens, instructions of 1,000, material of 5,000, history of 1,000 and output of 1,500 exceed the limit by 500.

misconceptions.zh: 词元不等于中文字数，实际计数依模型分词器。
misconceptions.en: Tokens are not the same as Chinese character counts; actual counts depend on the model's tokenizer.

evidence.quote: all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself.
The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

explanation.zh: 资料能放入窗口不代表所有内容都会被正确使用。优先提供当前问题相关、获授权且版本明确的片段，并验证回答是否真正引用了支持结论的内容。
explanation.en: Material fitting in the window does not mean all of it will be used correctly. Prioritize passages relevant to the current question, authorized for use and clearly versioned; verify that the answer actually cites content supporting its conclusions.

examples.zh: 只取当前退款政策相关段落，而不是拼进所有部门手册。
examples.en: Retrieve only the passages relevant to the current refund policy instead of concatenating every department's handbook.

misconceptions.zh: 上下文容量不是事实准确率的保证。
misconceptions.en: Context capacity does not guarantee factual accuracy.

evidence.quote: The size of the context window determines the maximum number of tokens that the model can “pay attention to” at any one time.

title.en: The retrieval and generation checks in RAG

explanation.zh: RAG先检索资料，再把相关片段提供给模型生成。分别评估是否找对资料，以及回答是否被资料支持；同时维护版本、权限和缺失证据时的处理。
explanation.en: RAG retrieves material first and supplies relevant passages to a model for generation. Separately evaluate whether the right material was found and whether it supports the answer; also maintain versions, permissions and a procedure for missing evidence.

examples.zh: 政策更新后重建索引，并测试旧版本是否仍被错误引用。
examples.en: After a policy update, rebuild the index and test whether the old version is still cited incorrectly.

misconceptions.zh: 有引用不等于引用支持结论。
misconceptions.en: Having a citation does not mean the cited material supports the conclusion.

evidence.quote: references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response.
Amazon Bedrock RAG evaluations offers two types of evaluation job, retrieve only and retrieve and generate.
produces outputs that sound plausible but are factually wrong, irrelevant or entirely fabricated.

explanation.zh: 微调通过训练调整参数，适合评估任务行为、格式或风格适配；外部资料频繁更新时，通常先评估检索和资料维护需求。两者可组合，但不能相互冒充。
explanation.en: Fine-tuning adjusts parameters through training and can be evaluated for adapting task behavior, format or style. When external material changes frequently, usually evaluate retrieval and material maintenance needs first. The two approaches can be combined, but must not be confused.

examples.zh: 统一客服回复风格可评估微调，今天更新的退货政策需要及时资料。
examples.en: Fine-tuning can be evaluated for consistent customer service style; a return policy updated today requires up-to-date material.

misconceptions.zh: 不要把微调当成随时更新的事实数据库。
misconceptions.en: Do not treat fine-tuning as a continuously updated factual database.

evidence.quote: fine-tuning entails techniques to further train a model whose weights have already been updated through prior training.

title.en: From business problems to use cases

explanation.zh: 先明确谁在什么流程中遇到什么问题，再把AI能力映射到可观察的业务结果。技术选择要服务目标。
explanation.en: First identify who faces what problem in which workflow, then map AI capabilities to observable business outcomes. Technology choices must serve the objective.

examples.zh: 教学例示（非来源原例）：将“做一个AI助手”改为“减少客服查找获授权制度的时间，同时保持答复质量”。
examples.en: Teaching illustration (not a source case): Replace 'build an AI assistant' with 'reduce the time customer support spends finding authorized policies while maintaining response quality'.

evidence.quote: Measurability: You can establish a baseline and set a clear target for improvement.

explanation.zh: 比较预算、交付时间、内部能力、供应商条件和合规需求。也要考虑集成、维护、迁移与持续运营成本。
explanation.en: Compare budget, delivery time, internal capabilities, supplier conditions, and compliance needs. Also consider integration, maintenance, migration, and ongoing operating costs.

examples.zh: 教学例示（非来源原例）：现有团队缺少运维能力时，不能只比较模型购买价格。
examples.en: Teaching illustration (not a source case): When the current team lacks operational capability, comparing model purchase prices alone is insufficient.

evidence.quote: This choice affects cost, timetovalue, risk, scalability, and the long-term sustainability of the solution.

explanation.zh: 综合商业价值、可行性、可持续性及战略契合度，决定扩展、暂停还是终止。先定义检验假设和停止条件。
explanation.en: Consider business value, feasibility, sustainability, and strategic fit together when deciding whether to scale, pause, or terminate a project. Define the hypotheses to test and the stopping conditions first.

examples.zh: 教学例示（非来源原例）：高潜在收益但数据不可用的项目，应先验证准备条件。
examples.en: Teaching illustration (not a source case): For a project with high potential returns but unavailable data, first verify that readiness conditions can be met.

evidence.quote: Measurability: You can establish a baseline and set a clear target for improvement.

explanation.zh: 当明确规则或流程改进已能解决问题，或错误风险与收益不相称时，AI可能不是合适选择。先比较可行替代方案。
explanation.en: AI may be unsuitable when explicit rules or process improvements already solve the problem, or when the risk of errors is disproportionate to the benefits. Compare feasible alternatives first.

examples.zh: 教学例示（非来源原例）：资料命名混乱导致找不到文件，可以先改进归档与检索。
examples.en: Teaching illustration (not a source case): If inconsistent document names make files hard to find, first improve filing and search.

examples.zh: 教学示例：新增地区前先确认本地资料、权限和支持接手。
examples.en: Teaching example: Before adding a region, confirm local source material, permissions, and support handover.

misconceptions.zh: 规模扩大时原有质量与成本假设可能失效。
misconceptions.en: Existing quality and cost assumptions may fail at a larger scale.

evidence.quote: Make sure that generative AI models can only retrieve information that the user is authorized to access.
Monitor and maintain generative AI applications in production.
Load test your workload to verify it can handle production load and identify any performance bottleneck.
Your recovery processes should be as well exercised as your normal production processes.
List the runbook owner and publish it in a central location.
